bullets.text: Q2 CR 87.3 companywide; Personal Lines CR 87.6 (including 4.0 pts CATs); personal vehicles CR 88.0; personal property CR 78.0 (13.5 pts CATs); Commercial Lines CR 85.3.
Companywide NPW +5% YOY; Personal Lines NPW +5% (+6% YTD); personal vehicles NPW +5%; personal property NPW +1%; Commercial Lines NPW +4% driven by core commercial auto.
Surpassed 40M total PIFs (+7% YOY); personal auto PIFs +9% (+2.2M); special lines added ~500k PIFs (exceeded 2M boat policies); personal property PIFs +1%.
Repurchased $1B+ common shares in 1H 2026; debt-to-capital under 20% post-$1.5B senior notes; portfolio returned 1.2% (fixed income 0.6%, equity 15.3%); investment income +12% to $979M.
Attained #1 U.S. private passenger auto rank based on trailing 12-month NPW at Q1 2026; personal auto conversion gained +5% YOY amid post-hard market competition.
Pricing adequate with margin buffer for weather; personal auto model 9.0 in 19 states; commercial auto targeted rate cuts taken; commercial model 8.3 in 21 states (model 8.4 Q3).
Commercial auto industry ex-Progressive recorded ~104 CR in Q1 2026; competitors continued mid-single-digit rate increases into Q2, improving Progressive's relative competitive position.
Property strategy prioritized lower-risk properties, reduced catastrophe exposures, and emphasized bundled homeowners; pivoting to expand availability where confident of target returns.
Investments scaled to drive growth; media spend +18% YTD through June YOY; agent incentive spend more than doubled to support conversion and quoting growth.
Personal Lines vehicle non-acquisition expense ratio improved 0.2 pts YTD YOY, reflecting ongoing expense discipline and operational efficiencies amid expanding volumes.
